title: Universal Studios Hollywood, Entertainment Creative Development, Production Design Internship – Summer 2027
term: Summer 2027 (Jun 7 – Aug 13 for semester schools; Jun 21 – Aug 27 for quarter schools)
note: Themed-entertainment design for live theme park events; Industrial Design is a named major, and applicants must be enrolled students (sophomore or above) authorized to work in the US without sponsorship.

facts.duties: Support production designers on live entertainment events at the theme park: graphic design, 3D models, drafting, production packets and concept art, from concept through installation. Ends with a presentation to senior leaders.
facts.requirements: Actively enrolled in a degree program, sophomore standing or above (Spring 2027 graduates are eligible); 40 hours a week on-site with a flexible schedule; US work authorization without sponsorship. Preferred: theater, scenic or industrial design or architecture background, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, 3D modeling or rendering, GPA 2.8+.
facts.apply: Apply on the NBCUniversal job page with a resume and an unofficial transcript. Applications close December 18, 2026 at 11:55 PM PT.
